scope_note: Assignment-focused film: only Assignment 7 files are explained; other files are excluded with reasons. --game is the git archive of 4f88f1b in _scratch/src (LF line endings, as committed). The film's own captures live in capture/godot (SOURCES.md).

components.explanation: Clip 1, track_dust (the cycle): a Sprite2D frame track on AnimationPlayer MotionAnim in animations/motion_clips.tres, 4 cells at 10 fps, keys 0/0.1/0.2/0.3, LOOP_LINEAR, discrete, step 0.1, length 0.4; it reads assets/game/fx/track_dust_sheet.png (64x16, hframes 4, vframes 1), generated by tools/make_dust_sheet.gd; Dust built in tank.gd _ready(), shown behind the hull (DUST_BEHIND 34) while MOVING.

Clip 2, shoot (the committing action): a cutout rig baked from code by tools/bake_tank_clips.gd into animations/fire_clips.tres, played by FireAnim; Suspension (parent of hull and turret) dips 2 px and squashes (1.04, 0.96) on frame 1; 30 fps, step 1/30, LOOP_NONE; phase table startup 1 / active 1 / recovery 3; the student's frame strip v1 (FIXTURE) from previews/shoot_preview.

One authority per animated node (CHANGE-BRIEF.md table) and the two clocks: tank.gd adds Suspension above hull/turret because tank.gd writes their position every tick; both AnimationPlayers use ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS; the shell comes from the physics-tick counter in _weapon_tick(); measured shell P+2, clip frame 1 on P+3, 1 tick.

The motion and weapon state machine in tank.gd (IDLE/MOVING, READY/FIRING), interrupts in each phase (hit and death do not stop the shot; a second fire during FIRING is ignored), shown in scripted-input captures of scenes/main.tscn.

Read-backs and tests at 4f88f1b: test_clip_readback 49, test_anim_states 34 at 30/60/144, the new test_anim_edges 27 at 30/60/144, pins 11 with PIN-1/2/4 re-pinned +2 ticks; mutations in worktrees (M1-M7); the C1 sign blind spot; nothing drawn is proven headless.
Strip readings and tuning: the v1 squash (Claude ~5 %, the student kept it), dust strips v1-v3, TUNING.md revisions 1 and 2 (paler, 2x; DUST_BEHIND 14 -> 34), checked in all 8 facings.
The record: the brief, agent mistakes the student caught (skipped failing tests and their fixes, _run_all.sh, DUST_BEHIND guess, check_tools_parse), contributions, the source revision.

excerpts.text:
[sub_resource type="Animation" id="Animation_4jg4t"]
length = 0.4
loop_mode = 1
step = 0.1
tracks/0/type = "value"
tracks/0/imported = false
tracks/0/enabled = true
tracks/0/path = NodePath("DustMount/Dust:frame")
tracks/0/interp = 1
tracks/0/loop_wrap = true
tracks/0/keys = {
"times": PackedFloat32Array(0, 0.1, 0.2, 0.3),
"transitions": PackedFloat32Array(1, 1, 1, 1),
"update": 1,
"values": [0, 1, 2, 3]

var clip := Animation.new()
	var active_on := STARTUP                      # frame 1
	var recovery_on := STARTUP + ACTIVE           # frame 2
	var end_on := STARTUP + ACTIVE + RECOVERY     # frame 5
	clip.length = end_on / FPS
	clip.step = 1.0 / FPS
	clip.loop_mode = Animation.LOOP_NONE
	# A key's transition shapes the segment after it: 1.0 linear, 0.5 ease-out.
	var p := clip.add_track(Animation.TYPE_VALUE)
	clip.track_set_path(p, POS_PATH)
	clip.value_track_set_update_mode(p, Animation.UPDATE_CONTINUOUS)
	clip.track_insert_key(p, 0.0, REST_POS, 1.0)
	clip.track_insert_key(p, active_on / FPS, DOWN_POS, 0.5)
	clip.track_insert_key(p, end_on / FPS, REST_POS, 1.0)

suspension.add_child(hull)
	turret = Sprite2D.new()
	turret.scale = Vector2(0.5, 0.5)
	turret.position = TURRET_OFFSET
	suspension.add_child(turret)
	var motion_anim := AnimationPlayer.new()
	motion_anim.name = "MotionAnim"
	motion_anim.root_node = NodePath("..")
	motion_anim.callback_mode_process = AnimationMixer.ANIMATION_CALLBACK_MODE_PROCESS_PHYSICS
	motion_anim.add_animation_library("", load("res://animations/motion_clips.tres"))
	add_child(motion_anim)
	var fire_anim := AnimationPlayer.new()
	fire_anim.name = "FireAnim"
	fire_anim.root_node = NodePath("..")

code_result_pairs.observation: The frame track just read (DustMount/Dust:frame, keys 0/0.1/0.2/0.3 -> cells 0-3, loop linear, discrete) beside the 64x16 sheet it slices; in the scripted-input capture the pale puffs behind the hull change every few frames while the runtime readout shows MOVING, track_dust playing and Dust.frame cycling 0 -> 3.

The baked key times (position 0/0.0333/0.1667, scale 0/0.0333/0.0667) beside the brief's phase table, and the student's FIXTURE strip v1: the tank is down and squashed on N+1 with the muzzle flash and shell, recovering on N+2 and at rest by N+5.

In the scripted-input capture: while move_right is held MotionAnim plays track_dust and the dust shows behind the hull; on release the readout shows IDLE, MotionAnim stopped, DustMount hidden; on fire FireAnim plays shoot and Suspension y reaches 2.00 on N+1 while the hull keeps its own per-tick position.

Held frames 84-91 of the drive capture: on frame 86 (N+1) the readout logs the shell, muzzle flash and fire sound on tick 2 while FireAnim reads 0.0333 s after tick 3; READY on tick 10 (frame 90). The side panel gives check C1's measured P+2 / P+3, 1 tick = 0.0167 s.
